claims.claim: GE Aerospace Q2 2026 reported $16.5B orders (+17%), $13.3B GAAP revenue (+21%), $2.7B adjusted operating profit (+18%) and $3.0B free cash flow (+43%), while raising full-year guidance.
On September 8 GE Aerospace agreed to acquire Consolidated Precision Products for $11.75B to expand mission-critical casting capacity serving commercial engines, aftermarket and defense.

risks.risk: The $11.75B CPP transaction adds integration and capital-allocation risk even as it targets a known casting bottleneck.
Q2 operating margin contracted despite strong growth, reflecting mix, investment and inflation pressure.

unknowns.unknown: Transaction closing conditions and realized post-close capacity economics remain forward-looking.

claims.claim: GE is converting strong aerospace demand into higher deliveries and cash while directly addressing a casting-capacity constraint; the execution test is whether supplier/casting expansion sustains delivery growth without further margin degradation.

risks.risk: Capacity acquisition is an execution response, not proof that supply-chain constraints are already resolved.

unknowns.unknown: Scout did not independently quantify CPP integration synergies or acquisition-return thresholds.
